text_en: Therefore when we could bear it no longer, we decided to be left alone in Athens;
text_cn: 为此，我们不能再等待，就决意独自留在雅典，

text_en: and we sent Timothy, our brother and co-worker for God in proclaiming the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you for the sake of your faith,
text_cn: 而打发我们的弟兄和在基督的福音上，作天主仆人的弟茂德前去，为在信德上坚固鼓励你们，

text_en: so that no one would be shaken by these persecutions. Indeed, you yourselves know that this is what we are destined for.
text_cn: 不叫任何人在这些困苦中受到动摇；你们自己原也知道：我们是注定要受苦的，

text_en: In fact, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we were to suffer persecution; so it turned out, as you know.
text_cn: 因为我们还在你们那里的时候，已给你们预言了，我们将遭受磨难；你们看，现在就发生了。

text_en: For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith; I was afraid that somehow the tempter had tempted you and that our labor had been in vain.
text_cn: 为此，我既不能再等待，遂派他去探悉你们的信德，怕那诱惑者诱惑了你们，而使我们的劳苦等于白费了。

text_en: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and has brought us the good news of your faith and love. He has told us also that you always remember us kindly and long to see us—just as we long to see you.
text_cn: 现今，弟茂德从你们那里回到我们这里，对你们的信德和爱德，给我们报告了好消息；并说你们时常想念我们，渴望见到我们，就像我们渴望见到你们一样。

text_en: For this reason, brothers and sisters, during all our distress and persecution we have been encouraged about you through your faith.
text_cn: 为此，弟兄们，我们在一切磨难困苦中，因了你们的信德，由你们获得了安慰。

text_en: For we now live, if you continue to stand firm in the Lord.
text_cn: 因为若是你们在主内站立稳定，我们现在就能活下去。

text_en: How can we thank God enough for you in return for all the joy that we feel before our God because of you?
text_cn: 我们为了你们的原故，在我们的天主前甚为喜乐：对这一切喜乐，我们能怎样感谢，好为你们称谢天主呢？

text_en: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you face to face and restore whatever is lacking in your faith.
text_cn: 我们惟有黑夜白日恳切祈求，为能见到你们的面，为能弥补你们信德的缺陷。

text_en: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus direct our way to you.
text_cn: 但愿天主我们的父和我们的主耶稣，铺平我们去你们那里的道路。

text_en: And may the Lord make you increase and abound in love for one another and for all, just as we abound in love for you.
text_cn: 愿主使你们彼此间的爱情，和对众人的爱情增长满溢，就像我们对你们所有的爱情，

text_en: And may he so strengthen your hearts in holiness that you may be blameless before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
text_cn: 好坚固你们的心，使你们在我们的主耶稣同他的众圣者来临时，于天主我们的父前，在圣德上无可指摘。
